column1: # core/data/story/register.tsv - the PG-21 register words (owner: E5;
# WORD   lowercase; matched case-insensitively as a whole word in the visible
#        text (line codes, @P and @E removed; '/' line breaks count as
#        spaces). A space matches any run of spaces or '/'. A trailing *
#        matches any ending (shit* = shit, shitty, shits), a leading *
#        crude   adult crude humour: booze, hangovers, adult body talk (R2)
# CAP    optional: the most uses in the WHOLE game (every pack, every
#        language source), checked by the lint (rule C1). DECISIONS 23:
#        swearing is sparse, the s-word a few times in all, the f-word
#        exactly twice (once cut off mid-word, which no list can catch:
#        "Oh, f-" is a reviewer's check; once in full near the end).
# Every listed word is banned from any script whose cast includes a kid, a
# teen, the kid-coded cast or (sexual class only) the pet
# (core/data/story/kid_cast.txt). It is NOT a list of words adults may not
# say: adults may say any of them within R1-R2 and the caps.
# Deliberately NOT listed (they are cartoon-safe, or too ambiguous to lint
# without false positives; reviewers read for them): butt, fart, burp,
# poop, "hell" alone (the place: Hell Pits, Hell Breach, Hellvile), kiss and
# smooch (grannies kiss foreheads; romance is the LOVE face, rule K2), the
# "WooHoo" of DECISIONS (also a cheer), bloody (gore wording, R5), sugar,
# darlin', handsome (Grumbleguts' pet names are fine, his innuendo is not:
# R2 keeps him away from kids by cast), escort (a mission verb), strip
